propositions: Test doubles that replace anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with functions cause a TypeError when pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is first imported, because the provider module evaluates a union type that cannot use | with a function.
Three held-out tests in test_rp04_s4_llm_runtime_heldout.py fail or pass depending on whether the Anthropic provider module is already loaded, violating test isolation.

The root defect is test-double representation, not production authentication logic; replacing function-shaped patches with class-shaped doubles that preserve the fail-if-constructed contract fixes the issue without changing production code.
A child-process oracle that verifies the provider is absent from sys.modules and runs the affected nodes must observe the intended secret-free LLMConfigError, not a dependency import TypeError.
